name: Rollback reconstruction cannot downgrade the current static spine

applicability.reason: Supported. C065 forbids a same-major rollback from DOWNGRADING the current static spine and requires it to publish nothing. The rollback surface existed and verified the artifact digest C066 governs, but its own comment claimed the current spine was validated while the target Class was discarded, so an artifact omitting a currently declared Contract rolled back happily. The downgrade check is now real: a declared Contract, or one of its required members, missing from the artifact fails with TypeContractError, the same refusal `remove_contract` gives for falsifying the same static promise. Verified against fixtures/meta/v922-compatible that an artifact KEEPING both still rolls back, so the refusal comes from the downgrade rather than from rollback being unavailable.
